text.14:15: And they sought help (from their Lord) and every froward potentate was bought to naught;
text.20:61: Moses said unto them: Woe unto you! Invent not a lie against Allah, lest He extirpate you by some punishment. He who lieth faileth miserably.
text.20:111: And faces humble themselves before the Living, the Eternal. And he who beareth (a burden of) wrongdoing is indeed a failure (on that day).
text.91:10: And he is indeed a failure who stunteth it.
